title: ByteSequenceV1
description: Proposed representation of an arbitrary finite byte sequence, with optional embedded bytes, external locations, digests, and external content identifiers. This schema is not yet canonical.

byteLength.description: Length of the raw byte sequence when known.

digests.description: Fingerprints computed directly over the raw byte sequence.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm identifier, for example sha-256.

value.description: Digest value encoded as lowercase hexadecimal unless the named algorithm specifies another representation.

identifiers.description: External content identifiers such as ni: or swh: URIs. These are distinct from raw-byte digests because an external identifier scheme may define its own framing or semantics.

data.description: The raw byte sequence embedded in the JSON document.

locations.description: URI-references from which the same byte sequence may be retrieved.
